motivation: Gold/silver convergence, error-correction, adaptive-equilibrium, macro-conditioned and pair-regime lineages did not establish executable edge. This protocol moves to a structurally orthogonal mechanism: intraday XAUUSD reaction, continuation and reversal around scheduled U.S. CPI, Employment Situation and FOMC statement releases.

market_data.source_timezone: fixed EST UTC-05:00 with no daylight-saving adjustment

event_sources.event_clock_conversion: convert official America/New_York release timestamp to UTC, then to fixed UTC-05:00 HistData clock; this handles EDT/EST correctly without altering market data timestamps

impulse5_continuation.direction: sign of event-open to fifth-minute-close return
impulse5_continuation.strength: absolute signal return divided by pre-event 60-minute high-low range percentage

impulse5_reversal.direction: negative sign of event-open to fifth-minute-close return
impulse5_reversal.strength: absolute signal return divided by pre-event 60-minute high-low range percentage

range_breakout5_continuation.eligibility: fifth-minute close is above pre-event 60-minute high or below pre-event 60-minute low
range_breakout5_continuation.strength: distance of fifth-minute close beyond breached pre-event boundary divided by pre-event range

liquidity_sweep5_reversal.eligibility: first-five-minute high breaches pre-event high and fifth-minute close returns at/below it, or first-five-minute low breaches pre-event low and fifth-minute close returns at/above it; skip if both sides sweep
liquidity_sweep5_reversal.strength: maximum boundary overshoot divided by pre-event range

state_first.target: uncosted signed open-to-open return from first tradable minute after completed signal window to frozen horizon exit
state_first.multiple_testing_family: all event-type x state-family x horizon hypotheses in this frozen protocol

execution.signal_completion: after the first five event minutes are fully observed
execution.entry: open of the next available one-minute bar after signal completion
execution.exit: open after 15, 30 or 60 frozen holding minutes
execution.cost_note: M1 source contains bid bars but no contemporaneous ask; cost stress therefore represents spread plus slippage and must not be reduced after inspection

neighborhood_gate.definition: same event type and family; adjacent horizon is the only neighborhood dimension
